B05-02のバッチ入口が新規追加済み。`src/Eccube/Command/ResendMailCommand.php:34` `#[AsCommand(name: 'eccube:resend-mail', description: '購入完了手続き再処理')]`、`:26` PHPDoc「購入完了手続き再処理バッチ（B05-02）」、`:49` `$summary = $this->resendMailAction->handle();`。実処理 `src/Eccube/Service/Admin/Order/ResendMailAction.php:61` `$Orders = $this->orderRepository->getNotSendMailOrders();` でメール未送信受注を取得し、`:74-80` ポイント処理、`:88` `$this->shoppingService->updateStock($Order, $orderNumber);` で在庫、`:90` `$this->mailService->resendOrderMail($Order, $this->getLang($Order->getCustomer()));` でメール再送信を行う。

results.evidence: `src/Eccube/Service/Admin/Order/ResendMailAction.php:74-80` `if ($Order->getSpendedPoints() > 0) { if (!$this->pointHistoryRepository->hasSpendPointHistoryForOrder($Order)) { $this->pointService->spendPoints($Order); } ... }` で受注サブの消費ポイントとポイント履歴有無を照合。冪等判定は `src/Eccube/Repository/DtbPointHistoryRepository.php:402-413` `->where('ph.Order = :order')->andWhere('ph.pointChange < 0')`（dtb_point_history.order_id 利用）。ポイント履歴作成と残高減算は `src/Eccube/Service/PointService.php:140-159` `$pointChange = $spendedPoints * $sign; $Player->setPoint($Player->getPoint() + $pointChange);` ＋ `$this->pointHistoryEntityManager->save(null, $Customer, $Order, $PointType, $pointChange, ...)`。

'en' : 'ja'; }` で会員都道府県が海外なら英語、それ以外は日本語。再送は `:90` `$this->mailService->resendOrderMail($Order, $this->getLang($Order->getCustomer()));`、テンプレート選択は `src/Eccube/Service/MailService.php:2565-2567` `$MailTemplate = ($lang === 'ja' || $lang === '') ? $Payment->getMailTemplateJp() : $Payment->getMailTemplateEn();`（監査時点の `getCurrentLocale()` 依存ではない専用メソッド）。送信履歴登録は `src/Eccube/Service/MailService.php:2641-2642` `$this->mailHistoryEntityManager->save($message, $Order->getBaseInfo(), $Order, $MailTemplate); $this->entityManager->flush();`。
